author: KEXP
description: Led by Jane Fitzsimmons and Ian Jones, TWEN stand confident with their catchy, kaleidoscopic DIY indie rock sound. Live on KEXP with host DJ Evie Stokes, the band share a performance of "Tumbleweed" and more.
title: TWEN performs "Tumbleweed" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents TWEN performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded April, 2026.

Songs:
Allnighter 00:34
Tumbleweed 05:04
Godlike 07:47
HaHaHome 13:25

Jane Fitzsimmons - Lead Vox
